gui.essentialcraft5.redstone_transmitter.en: Put in a bound gem that remembers the transmitter to listen to.
gui.essentialcraft5.redstone_transmitter.zh: 放进一颗记住了要收听的那个传递器的绑定宝石

gui.essentialcraft5.redstone_transmitter.en: Sneak and right-click the other transmitter with the gem first.
gui.essentialcraft5.redstone_transmitter.zh: 先拿着宝石潜行右键另一个传递器

gui.essentialcraft5.redstone_transmitter.en: Both transmitters must be in the same dimension.
gui.essentialcraft5.redstone_transmitter.zh: 两个传递器必须在同一个维度

gui.essentialcraft5.redstone_transmitter.en: Bind the gem to the other transmitter, not to this one.
gui.essentialcraft5.redstone_transmitter.zh: 宝石要绑到另一个传递器上

gui.essentialcraft5.redstone_transmitter.en: The other transmitter and the area around it must be loaded.
gui.essentialcraft5.redstone_transmitter.zh: 另一个传递器和它周围要在加载范围里

gui.essentialcraft5.redstone_transmitter.en: There is no redstone transmitter where the gem points.
gui.essentialcraft5.redstone_transmitter.zh: 宝石指向的地方没有红石传递器

gui.essentialcraft5.redstone_transmitter.en: The other transmitter must not touch another transmitter.
gui.essentialcraft5.redstone_transmitter.zh: 另一个传递器旁边不能紧挨着别的传递器

gui.essentialcraft5.redstone_transmitter.en: Gives out the signal that reaches the other transmitter.
gui.essentialcraft5.redstone_transmitter.zh: 输出另一个传递器那一格收到的红石信号
